Name: JP's Small Fruit Tree Framework
Author: juanpa98ar
Description:
[font=Georgia][size=6][b][i][color=#00ff00][u][center]Small Fruit Tree Framework[/center][/u][/color][/i][/b][/size]

[color=#ff00ff][size=5][b][i]Because your tree is so beautiful when it's a sprout, then it grows and you decide to flush it down the toilet... Then it feeds on rats and other bugs and comes back to take revenge with its mutant fruit.[/i][/b][/size][/color]


[size=5][i][color=#ff7700]NOTE:[/color] [color=#ffff00]This mod does nothing on its own; it depends on other users creating their own Content Packs by adding fruit trees with the new logic.[/color]
[color=#ff7700]NOTE 2:[/color] [color=#ffff00]Currently, apart from a template to show how to use the framework, there are no trees created for the mod, not even those from the base game. You are more than welcome to create them for the mod![/color][/i][/size]


[size=3][b]This mod allows you to use fully functional 16x32 and 16x16 trees that bear fruit!
These trees have fewer placement restrictions, so you can customize them more to your liking and put them in a special pot!
A special pot is added, the recipe for which you will receive when you see the event where Evelyn gives you the original pot when rebuilding the greenhouse.
This pot is only suitable for Small Fruit Trees and allows for simpler tree logic.[/b][/size]


[color=#00ff00][size=4][b][i]I will briefly discuss the framework's features, as I will provide a template in the [u]downloads section[/u] showing how to apply the Small Fruit Tree logic, as well as a guide for those who want to create their own trees and have no previous experience with Content Patcher. [/i][/b][/size][/color]


[color=#00ffff][size=5][b][i][u]Everything configurable so far:[/u][/i][/b][/size][/color]

[list]
[*][font=Georgia][size=4]Tree maturation days[/size][/font]
[*][font=Georgia][size=4]Tree maturation speed[/size][/font]
[*][font=Georgia][size=4]Tree maturation speed when it rains[/size][/font]
[*][font=Georgia][size=4]Tree maturation speed in a specific season[/size][/font]
[*][font=Georgia][size=4]Count only the days when you harvest fruit so that the tree can produce higher quality fruit[/size][/font]
[*][font=Georgia][size=4]Days for fruit quality to increase[/size][/font]
[*][font=Georgia][size=4]Maximum fruit allowed[/size][/font]
[*][font=Georgia][size=4]Days for the tree to bear fruit again after a harvest[/size][/font]
[*][font=Georgia][size=4]Extra seasons in which the tree can bear fruit in addition to the main season[/size][/font]
[*][font=Georgia][size=4]Days for the tree to bear fruit again after a harvest in an extra season other than the main season[/size][/font]
[*][font=Georgia][size=4]Tree size, which can be 16x32 or 16x16[/size][/font]
[*][font=Georgia][size=4]Fruit size, a visual effect to match the size of the tree[/size][/font]
[*][font=Georgia][size=4]Lifespan of the tree, number of axe blows it can withstand[/size][/font]
[*][font=Georgia][size=4]It can be planted in a pot[/size][/font]
[*][font=Georgia][size=4]Location of the fruits on the tree[/size][/font]
[/list]

[b][color=#00ff00][size=3]That's all for now. The modder is responsible for the artistic design and logical configuration of their trees. It is entirely possible to create a normal version, a small version, and a very small version, but they must be independent of each other. [/size][/color][/b]


[b][i][color=#ffff00][size=6][u]Translations[/u][/size][/color][/i]
[/b][b][size=4]You are free to translate the mod; [color=#ff0000]you don't need to ask my permission[/color].
You can publish it yourself on Nexusmods.
If you like, you can also let me know that your translation has been published, so I know you're out there.[/size][/b]


[color=#00ffff][size=4][b][i]The i18n files in the “SmallFruitTrees” and “[CP] Small Fruit Tree Pot” folders need to be translated.[/i][/b][b][i]
[/i][/b][b][i]One suggestion is that you can also translate the Template, including its comments, and upload it yourself, so that people in their respective languages can better understand how the code works. [/i][/b][/size][/color]
